units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>...Oh, did I fall asleep again? I just had a dream. I dreamt of—rusted brown-red shades, an endless song…</color>
units.displayText: ...Oh, did I fall asleep again? I just had a dream. I dreamt of—rusted brown-red shades, an endless song…

spans.text: ...Oh, did I fall asleep again? I just had a dream. I dreamt of—rusted brown-red shades, an endless song…

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>and I saw... your silhouette, drifting further and further away, brilliant gems scattered across the realm... what a marvelous dreamscape. One can hardly bring themselves to look away.</color>

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Professor, tell me... is the end of a star another form of eternal sleep?</color>
